description: Start a bulk test script generation workflow to generate scripts for multiple test cases in a single request.

testCaseIds.description: Optional: targeted test case UUIDs to generate scripts for; when absent generates for all eligible test cases in the project

workflowParams.description: Optional workflow parameters for workflow-level overrides

llm.description: Model tier override. tier 'light' runs the Standard tier (Claude Sonnet 5.5, faster and lower cost); tier 'standard' runs the Premium tier (Claude Opus 5.5, the default). Omit to inherit the project/use case/test case setting.

maxRunTimeMs.description: Max runtime per workflow kind, in milliseconds (60000–3600000). The run fails as timed out once it exceeds this. Omit a kind to inherit the project/use case/test case setting, else its built-in limit.

enableEverMemOS.description: Override to enable/disable EverMemOS for this workflow run

enableSharedTestMemory.description: Override to enable/disable SharedTestMemory for this workflow run

name: muggle-remote-workflow-start-test-script-generation-bulk
